# 🏪 KrishiAI — Vendor Domain

This directory contains **Vendor-specific domain models, validation schemas, files, constants, and resources**.

## Directory Structure

- `profile/`: Vendor business identity profiles, KYC validation schemas, and sample benchmark datasets
- `files/`: Trade licenses, APMC permits, GST certificate templates, and upload storage
- `constants/`: Document types, AI crop grading benchmarks, and commission metrics
